name: RETURN Machine.Love()
source:
Since the very moment the first mechanical mind became aware of itself,  it craved love.
No one truly understand why the heart made of copper and wires started beating, but it did.
Even after we were gone.
And this is their stories.

[From [url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/return-machinelove]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从第一个机械思维意识到自己的那一刻起，它就渴望爱。
没有人真正理解为什么由铜和电线制成的心脏开始跳动，但它确实开始跳动。
即使我们走了之后。
这就是他们的故事。

[来自[url=https://uberthemeh.itch.io/return-machinelove]itch.io[/url]]
